correctness.rationale: Gerretsen's upper inequality \(s^2\le4R^2+4Rr+3r^2\) and Euler's \(R\ge2r\) give \(p-4R\le r\Phi(r/R)\), where \(\Phi\) is increasing on \((0,1/2]\) and \(\Phi(1/2)=6\sqrt3-8\). For a lattice-free triangle the incenter lies within \(\sqrt2/2\) of a lattice point, so an open incircle with larger radius would contain an interior lattice point. Hence \(r\le\sqrt2/2\) and the stated constant follows. A fresh grid check verified positivity of the derivative numerator and the exact numerical constant; the proof is analytic.
residual_risks: The absolute constant is not claimed sharp for lattice-free triangles.
